g.text: One TIM6 tick moves one frame along the line; every 256 ticks a block goes to the PC
Step 1 loopback on the NUCLEO-H755ZI-Q, drawn along the data path: read left to right
CM4 core: unused, waits in Stop mode
S0, S1 read 1 sample a tick, wrap after 512
S2 writes 2 a tick (rank 1, rank 2), wraps after 1024
AXI SRAM because DMA1 cannot reach DTCM
plays DAC A, fills ADC A
plays DAC B, fills ADC B
plays DAC A, fills ADC A
DAC A, B filled at start
refill DAC A, send ADC A
refill DAC B, send ADC B
refill DAC half k with the next 256 samples
Ping-pong: DMA1 works on one half while the CM7 handles the other
